description: This file contains internal utility functions for network host address validation and detection of Android emulator environments. It includes functions to check if a host is a loopback or private LAN address, parse IPv4 addresses, and detect if running on an Android emulator runtime.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost
methods.description: Checks if a given host string refers to a loopback address, including IPv4 and IPv6, considering emulator bridge addresses.

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost
methods.description: Determines if a given host string is a private LAN address or local network, including loopback and link-local addresses.

methods.name: isAndroidEmulatorRuntime
methods.description: Detects if the current runtime environment is an Android emulator based on device build properties.

methods.name: parseIpv4Address
methods.description: Parses a string as an IPv4 address and returns its byte array representation if valid.

methods.name: isIpv6LiteralChar
methods.description: Checks if a character is valid in an IPv6 literal address.
